Name: Better Storage (v0.15 Update)
Description:
[h3]NOT COMPATIBLE WITH V0.14![/h3]

Expands storage options with larger storage facilities, refrigerators, and beverage coolers.

This is a Stardeus v0.15 compatibility update of the original Better Storage mod. The goal of this release is to preserve the original functionality and gameplay intent while restoring compatibility with current versions of Stardeus.

Compatibility updates include:

• Stardeus v0.15 schema and definition updates
• Added missing InPort and OutPort definitions required by current game versions
• Updated deprecated Flammable component properties to current Core naming conventions
• Updated ParentId references to align with current Core storage hierarchy
• Added TranslationVars support for storage facilities where supported by Core
• Added UseParentTexts support for storage facilities where compatible
• Restored proper storage naming and menu integration
• Removed deprecated definitions and validation warnings
• General compatibility, stability, and maintenance improvements

2.0.4 maintenance: The four custom cold-storage variants use Core's native electricity requirement for hauling. Custom fridges use native power demand (2 kW plus 5 W per stored unit). Capacities, construction work, ingredients, and research are unchanged.

Additional language support (created via AI to at least provide minimal support, any corrections welcomed!):
• English
• Chinese (Simplified)
• German
• Russian
- French

Original mod:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2878153161

Full credit for the original mod belongs to the original author. This upload exists solely to provide continued compatibility with current versions of Stardeus after the original mod became outdated.

If the original author returns and publishes an official update, I will gladly defer to their version.
